summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (44 tests) under the shared venv Python. Nothing was committed. Lint (ruff/black) could not be run because those tools are not in the shared venv; line lengths were checked by hand. Known caveats: core SequencePath and AlternativePath flatten nested instances of their own type, so nested groupings are not preserved structurally, and the empty-sequence test case is rejected via the rdf:nil branch rather than the list-length check.
